packageRules.description: Riverpod only moves as a set: the generator, the annotation and the runtime share an analyzer constraint.
drift and drift_dev are pinned together to the last version whose analyzer range overlaps riverpod_generator. See docs/dependencies.md.
sqlite3 3.x requires drift 2.34, which the pin above blocks, and sqlite3_flutter_libs 0.6.0 is an empty tombstone release. See docs/dependencies.md.
intl is dictated by the flutter_localizations that ships with the pinned SDK, so it moves with the SDK and not on its own.
flutter_rust_bridge is held at the version metadata_god was generated against; anything newer fails its own runtime check.
Gradle and AGP 9.x need a CargoKit that builds without the exec() Gradle 9 removed. See docs/dependencies.md.
Actions and lint rules are safe to take without review noise.
